scope_limitations: Fresh one-case independent critic judgment for these 18 supplied targets at 1240×900 and 390×900. No builder or prior reviewer conclusions were read. This is not a claim of using separate Impeccable/UI UX Pro Max/web-design-guidelines specialist skills.

Keyboard/DOM/live-region behavior was observed in Headless Edge. No actual screen-reader speech session, browser matrix, zoom matrix, touch-device trial, failure injection or backend behavior was tested. PASS covers the stated supplied-state criteria, not general accessibility certification.

The supplied originals establish the overview identity and relationships. The extension composition remains a DRAFT; this review does not create exact user acceptance or authorize installation, release or whole-product completion.

Local baseline, frame and response hashes match the inspected bytes. These records and independent probes are unauthenticated local evidence; they do not authenticate approval, protect the host or prevent bypass.

Wide responsive claims were assessed together with their corresponding inspected narrow target. Static PNGs alone were not used to assert transitions; behavior claims also cite matching observation JSON and independent probes.

source_inspection: All current app HTML/CSS/JS runtime files
method.visual_inspection: Opened and compared all 18 full PNGs and both reference PNGs; additionally inspected planning narrow initial/reserved viewport PNGs and independent participant keyboard screenshots. No contact-sheet-only substitution.
method.behavior: Read actual per-target actions, raw rendered text, controls, measurements and response hashes. Independently served current runtime via one own ephemeral loopback HTTP server; reproduced keyboard room/session selection, reservation activation, navigation/reload and separate overview reservation at both widths. Server and browser were closed in finally.
method.geometry: Inspected pinned geometry definitions and rendered relationships; all 117 recorded geometry checks satisfy expected counts and ranges. No duplicate geometry claim rows emitted. The baseline has no numeric row-gap check, so independently measured the actual date/details/action edges: 18px desktop and 14px narrow, with consistent values across all 12 planning rows. Specialist Craft/VisualConformance scope still covers these relationships.
method.integrity: All frame_hashes verified against current PNG bytes and all recorded served-response SHA256 values verified against current runtime files; no mismatch found.

nonblocking_observations: At 390px the native participant select clips the long selected label, but the full session title, date, time and room are immediately repeated below it and the session remains identifiable.

The twelve-session narrow planning page is long, with visitor material after the list as explicitly required. All rows remain reachable and consistently grouped; no material list-scale failure was found.
